answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and posts a lotus bounty on the ocean board, paying 40 to anyone proving a shared key. Each epoch a pulse beacon draws one identity in ten for auditors to replay its filings. A shared key pays the bounty and burns the bond, so a rented-bounty ring loses twice. First bounty 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
